title: TEKEX events
description: Every event with a write-up: each gets its own page (events/<slug>.html); those still to come lead the Events page and the homepage. build/build.py checks build/data/events.json against this file before it writes anything, so a CMS set up from this schema can't publish an event the site can't show.

slug.description: Its address, events/<slug>.html, and its anchor on the Events page. Lowercase words joined by hyphens. Don't change it once published: links to it are out there.

title.description: The event's name, as TEKEX writes it: "TEKEX #36", "TEKEX #35: Female Founders".

titleLines.description: How the title breaks over two lines on its page, if not at ": ".

type.description: The format. Showcase: founders and experts on stage, then the room networks (the TEKEX evening). Social: an evening to meet, no stage. Breakfast: a morning session. Workshop: hands-on (bootcamps, hacks). Special: a one-off format.

series.description: The numbered series it belongs to, if any: TEKEX (Jersey, #36), TEKEX IOM (Isle of Man, IOM3), TEKEX GSY (Guernsey, GSY5). Needs an edition.

edition.description: Its number in the series: 36 for TEKEX #36.

label.description: The big label in the archive for an event outside a numbered series ("Social", "AI Sprint"). Required when there's no series.

theme.description: A theme, for grouping and filtering: "Female Founders", "AI".

end.description: Finish, local island time, if known.

doors.description: Doors open, if different from the start: 16:45.

islands.description: Where it happens. Two for an event streamed between islands.

note.description: How it's held, if that matters: "streamed to Guernsey".

strap.description: One line that sells it. Shown under the title everywhere.

description.description: The write-up, a paragraph per item. The first is set larger. Don't list collaborators here: use partners.

talk.description: What they spoke on, if known: "Young people and AI".

partners.description: Collaborators. Printed for every event the same way: "In collaboration with A, B and C."

price.description: "Free", or the ticket price as it's sold: "£15".

registration.description: Where to register or book (Eventbrite). Shown as Register now while the event is still to come.

file.description: The artwork, 2:1: assets/photography/events/<file>-<width>.webp (build/asset-scripts/events/process.py makes them), or a path under assets/photography/.

alt.description: What the artwork shows, if more than "<title> event artwork".

photo.description: A photograph of the event itself, once it has happened: shown full width under the write-up on its page, with the photographer's credit. Web-size it with build/asset-scripts/photos/process.py.

file.description: A path under assets/photography/, without the width: "tekex/iom-room" is assets/photography/tekex/iom-room-<width>.webp.

alt.description: What it shows, for anyone who can't see it.

credit.description: The photographer, printed under it: "DK Photography IOM".

note.description: A line under the write-up: "All ticket proceeds go to …".
